title: NEWLY SINGLE
tagline: a soul leaves a body on a dance floor

dramatic.two_seconds_before: a soul leaves a body on a dance floor. Before frame 1 we are already inside 'PULSING': the city was moving before the camera arrived, so the opening beat is a stimulus already in progress, not a cold start.

beats.verb: something in the world changes — the figure against railing, wall, building
beats.line: Pulsing, and head throbbing from the music — and empty, on a crowded floor of sweated perfumes and temptations.

beats.verb: the body/camera loads against the coming move — the figure against railing, street lamp, building
beats.line: The soul escapes my body, and leaves him on the dance floor — just flesh and bones. Rejection and heartache hit different, with no feelings afloat.

beats.verb: the move reaches its extreme — the figure against street lamp, building, tree
beats.line: I want my soul to imagine my body. Watch strangers collide and spark electric currents that gamut the mood. We want him to be the last to leave.

beats.verb: the move lands and overshoots — the figure against street lamp, building, tree
beats.line: Now let us put my soul in the middle of an open field — at the equator of a planet much larger than my own, and much hotter.

beats.verb: the world settles into the aftermath — the figure against road, water, bridge
beats.line: Now bring my soul back to my body: to lean back, breathe in the smoke that fills the room — how good it is to finally get acquainted with the night.

flip_test.note: keys must differ enough to tell the story with no in-betweens
